points: This carryover audit supplements only G2 and G3; G0/G4/G5/G1 are inherited from the captured record.

A real Chrome session read the complete first two US-English pages without CAPTCHA. Both pages are almost entirely Google documentation inner pages: cluster upgrade, overview, release notes, versioning, downloads, lifecycle, security bulletins, pre-upgrade tooling, node pools and adjacent bare-metal material.

G2=pass: although one vendor owns the documentation set, the results are fragmented components rather than multiple task-completing pages or a homepage takeover. The natural query also marks 1.34.800 missing from generic upgrade pages, showing a version-specific quality gap.

The live downloads page, updated 2026-08-19 UTC, confirms 1.34.800-gke.90 as the current supported 1.34 patch and provides gkeadm and regular/full bundle paths plus signature verification. The upgrade guide, updated August 11, supplies the full control-plane and node-pool procedure.

G3=pass: the upgrade guide plus downloads/version pages form one complementary official implementation set, not multiple independent completions. No third-party page completes the 1.34.800 VMware upgrade across the two pages.
This is not veto_window_bet because there is only one exact implementation set and no second built guide awaiting indexing.
Window estimate is weeks, expiring 2026-09-20. The patch artifact is newly listed, while generic official upgrade documentation and a newer 1.35 branch create a short version-specific window.

Invalidation conditions: two free independent 1.34.800 VMware upgrade guides enter the SERP; Google publishes a version-specific codelab; 1.34.800-gke.90 support status, upgrade path, bundle/gkeadm artifact, signature, or compatibility requirements change.
